mentions.name: ETL product for business teams
mentions.description: This ETL product helps business teams better communicate what they want and produces ready-to-deploy tech artifacts without relying on AI. It is ready to launch, and a marketing site is being built for it.
mentions.problem: Business teams struggle to communicate what they want in a way that yields deployable tech artifacts.
mentions.audience: Business teams that need a better way to communicate what they want while getting ready-to-deploy tech artifacts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on the marketing site for an ETL Product that I am ready to launch, and this thread made me realize that I should ask in another thread about recommended MoR/affiliate programs for current day.

This is meant to be something that will help business teams be better able to communicate what they want, while producing ready to deploy tech artifacts that do not rely on AI.
mentions.author: tisdadd
